rows.note: This is the everyday lay description and the all-purpose choice in casual conversation.

example.english: My voice has gone hoarse; I might have laryngitis.
example.traditional: 我把聲沙晒，可能係喉嚨發炎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 baa2 seng1 saa1 saai3 ho2 nang4 hai6 hau4 lung4 faat3 jim4

rows.note: Use this more precise medical noun when naming the diagnosis rather than describing the symptom.

example.english: The doctor said I have laryngitis and need to rest for a few days.
example.traditional: 醫生話我係喉炎，要休息幾日。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 hai6 hau4 jim4 jiu3 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6
